question: Does the reproductive-versus-vegetative phylogenetic K advantage persist when the two traits are measured in the same contributing AusTraits dataset for the same species and compared on identical species and trees?

units.original_source_state: Median of all finite, native-unit, unique (genus,species,dataset_id,observation_id,value) records per original species for each trait; must reproduce original K species positive-median graph exactly.
units.positive_dataset_intersection: Species and genus must match across pair; dataset_id must have a finite positive native-unit source observation for BOTH traits. This selects a common set of dataset_id(s) for that pair/species before any new K result.
units.source_restricted_state: Median of all finite native-unit measurements from ONLY those dataset_id(s) shared by both traits for each exact species. Require both resulting medians positive, else source-restricted observation HOLD; no source substitution to rescue a pair.
units.reference_all_source_state: Original all-dataset median for the exact same surviving pair/species, NOT K on original independent-trait taxon sets.
units.excluded_source_names_for_outcome_select: NONE: cohorts selected by source dataset identity and positive support only, not by observed original organ K direction.
units.R_K_estimator: Natural log of positive median states, original exact real-tree phylosig(K) equivalent Rcpp with small tree parity against phytools::phylosig(method=K,test=FALSE).

target_comparisons.source_measurement_delta: common_dataset_delta - all_source_delta on the EXACT same matched species/branches/phylogeny
target_comparisons.compare_to_prior_760: Original 760 same-tip results use DIFFERENT matched taxon cohorts; do not attribute their contrast differences solely to source measurements. Report descriptive only.
target_comparisons.S3_axis: Original V.PhyloMaker2 scenario 3 built on pair-specific original common-dataset source species set
target_comparisons.prune_axis: Original native GBOTB prune-only with >=20 original observed tips; nonqualifying pair×tree HOLD

eligibility_and_stop.if_cannot_satisfy: Report source-specific identifiability limit, no new generalization claim.

summaries: Pair-weighted and equal-family reproductive-K-higher rate in full-source arm on restricted same-source taxon cohort and shared-dataset source arm, separately on S3/prune.
Paired within-family×pair sign flips attributable to changing measurement source on EXACT same tips/tree.
Mean/median source-composition change in cross-organ logK contrast and its family bootstrap sensitivity.
Within-source results by fruit vs vegetative, seed vs vegetative; and whether exceptions Casuarinaceae/Rubiaceae persist with sufficient source support.
Family and trait-pair counts and source-median holds; no raw species, specimen, dataset labels or phenotype values exported.
Data compatibility and observation key identity limitations.

hard_nonclaims: Same AusTraits dataset ID is NOT a proof of same original experiment, collector or specimen; datasets can be compilations and methods differ within them.
This is a post-outcome source composition robustness test on original AusTraits discovery data, not a holdout independent test of biological organ evolutionary constraints.
K describes phylogenetic signal conditioned on selected tips and covariance geometry, not independent selection/OU alpha/evolutionary speed.
Between-pair shared species sets can differ and cannot be treated as a universal global 12-trait ranking.
Historical TRY Kew and Tng overlaps and permissions remain open, closed BIEN 201-system rho study never reopened.
